map.DIC弥散性血管内凝血ISTH评分器，根据血小板计数、PT延长、纤维蛋白原、D-: A DIC scoring tool for disseminated intravascular coagulation (ISTH): it scores the DIC diagnosis from the platelet count, PT prolongation, fibrinogen and D-dimer or FDP. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.请填写血小板、PT 延长和纤维蛋白原，并选择标志物升高程度: Enter platelet count, PT prolongation and fibrinogen, and select the marker elevation category.
map.数值不能为负，请检查输入: Values cannot be negative; please check your input.
map.纤维蛋白相关标志物升高程度（按本地实验室判定）: Fibrin-related marker elevation (use local laboratory criteria)
map.总分≥5分提示符合显性 DIC；<5分尚不符合显性 DIC 标准，应结合临床动态: A score of 5 or more is consistent with overt DIC; below 5 does not meet the overt DIC criteria and requires clinical reassessment. An underlying condition capable of causing DIC is required.
map.提示：D-二聚体或 FDP 升高程度取决于检测方法及本地实验室阈值，请依据实验室: D-dimer or FDP elevation depends on the assay and local laboratory thresholds. Select the category according to laboratory criteria; this tool does not impose universal numerical cutoffs. For clinical reference only.
map.例（血小板=45、标志物中度升高、PT 延长=6s、纤维蛋白原=1.2）：2+2: Example: platelets 45, moderate marker elevation, PT prolongation 6 s and fibrinogen 1.2 give 2+2+2+0=6 points. With an underlying condition capable of causing DIC, this is consistent with overt DIC and requires clinical assessment.
map.ISTH 显性 DIC 评分：血小板 <50 加 2、50 至 <100 加 1: ISTH overt DIC score: platelets <50 add 2, 50 to <100 add 1; no, moderate and marked fibrin-related marker elevation add 0, 2 and 3; PT prolongation ≥6 seconds adds 2 and 3 to <6 seconds adds 1; fibrinogen <1 g/L adds 1. A score ≥5 suggests overt DIC. Assess marker elevation using local laboratory criteria.
map.ISTH 显性 DIC 评分：血小板 <50(+2)、50 至 <100(+1): ISTH overt DIC score: platelets <50 (+2), 50 to <100 (+1); no/moderate/marked fibrin-related marker increase scores 0/2/3; PT prolongation ≥6 seconds (+2), 3 to <6 seconds (+1); fibrinogen <1.0 (+1). With an underlying condition capable of causing DIC, ≥5 is consistent with overt DIC.
map.≥5 分提示符合显性 DIC；未达阈值仍需结合临床动态复评: A score ≥5 is consistent with overt DIC; below the threshold, reassess in clinical context.
map.ISTH 显性 DIC 评分要求存在可诱发 DIC 的基础疾病；JAAM 评分采: The ISTH overt DIC score requires an underlying condition capable of causing DIC. JAAM uses different indicators and thresholds for a different context.
map.不。未达到显性 DIC 阈值不能排除早期 DIC；应结合病情动态复评。: No. A score below the overt DIC threshold does not exclude early DIC; reassess in clinical context.
map.ISTH 显性 DIC 评分依据血小板、纤维蛋白相关标志物、PT 延长和纤维蛋白: The ISTH overt DIC score uses platelets, fibrin-related markers, PT prolongation and fibrinogen. Classify marker elevation using local laboratory criteria.
map.未达到显性 DIC 阈值不能排除早期 DIC；应结合病情动态复评: A score below the overt DIC threshold does not exclude early DIC; reassess in clinical context.
